title: 9 October 2015: Ringo Starr live at Queen Elizabeth Theatre, Vancouver, BC, Canada
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Queen Elizabeth Theatre in Vancouver, Canada, on 9 October 2015.

It was the 23rd show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

The concert took place on what would have been John Lennon’s 75th birthday.

It is 2 o'clock in the morning in the UK happy birthday John happy birthday to you love to Yoko and Sean peace and love xx?????

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 9, 2015

Peace and love have a great night tonight playing in Vancouver great crowd I love you all peace and love????????? pic.twitter.com/374WEgu6nN

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 10, 2015

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
